title: Easy King Ranch Chicken Casserole
description: This recipe makes a popular Tex-Mex casserole of chicken with creamy tomato sauce, tortillas, vegetables and Cheddar.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
3 cups cooked, diced chicken breast meat

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a shallow 3-quart casserole dish.
Combine broth, chicken soup, mushroom soup, and tomatoes with chiles in a large bowl; set aside.

Layer 1/2 each of tortillas, chicken, onion, bell pepper, and cheese in the prepared casserole dish. Pour 1/2 the soup mixture over layers. Repeat layers with remaining 1/2 each tortillas, chicken, onion, and bell pepper; pour remaining 1/2 soup mixture over top, then top with remaining 1/2 cheese. Sprinkle with chili powder and garlic salt.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes.
